test_title: PYST 55: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 10th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: On what sum of money can one earn Rs. 2,400 as simple interest at the rate of 8% per annum in 4 years?
solution:
Given:

Interest = Rs. 2400, Time = 4 years, Rate = 8% p.a. 

Concept used:

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

where, P = Principal amount
